ITEM 1 | Pale golden-yellow cubed pieces, about 2-3 cm each, with browned and slightly crisp edges and a glossy, lightly oily sheen; some pieces show a caramelized amber glaze; sits in the upper-center of the plate, roughly 15% of the plate footprint, stacked 1-2 cm high | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark brown to black-charred chunks, about 2 cm, with blistered, wrinkled skin and a glossy, slightly sticky glaze; scattered among the golden cubes and near the center-left of the plate, roughly 4% of the footprint, about 1-1.5 cm high | 25
ITEM 3 | Orange-red pieces with a soft, slightly glossy surface and charred dark patches on one edge, about 2 cm wide; sits between the golden cubes and the greens, roughly 3% of the footprint, about 1 cm high | 20
ITEM 4 | Small dark-skinned pieces with yellowish flesh, about 1.5 cm, with glossy, slightly charred skin; located at the left-center of the plate near the cubes, roughly 2% of the footprint, about 1 cm high | 12
ITEM 5 | Fresh dark green leafy greens with thin stems and ruffled edges, slightly wilted and glistening with a light oil or dressing sheen; spread across the right side of the plate, roughly 25% of the footprint, piled 2-3 cm high | 60
ITEM 6 | Pale white, soft, slightly translucent pieces with a moist surface, about 1-2 cm, scattered among the greens on the right edge; roughly 3% of the footprint, about 1 cm high | 15
ITEM 7 | Thin pale-brown bits with a crisp, slightly toasted look, scattered among the greens at the lower right; roughly 1% of the footprint, flat | 4
ITEM 8 | Clear, thin glossy film with small pale specks spread on the plate surface around the cubes and left-center, lightly sheening the white plate; roughly 5% of the footprint, a few millimeters thick | 8
